description: The chart represents the Token Routing Distribution for FedHLM, showing the proportion of tokens routed through different categories. The pie chart is divided into three slices, representing LOCAL, LLM, and EDGE_P2P. The largest slice, labeled LOCAL and colored green, occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart, with the percentage labeled inside the slice. The second-largest slice, labeled LLM and colored red, accounts for around 3.9%. The smallest slice, labeled EDGE_P2P and colored blue, represents about 1.6%. The chart does not include a legend, but the labels are placed outside the corresponding slices. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, with LOCAL being the largest and EDGE_P2P being the smallest.
